_comment: Local reference copy — created from live n8n on 2026-06-12 (V1.1 reconciliation, post-go-live QA finding). Live ID: WzWw9vCYOCS6dSSS. New workflow: detects when the owner manually changes an appointment's Appt Date/Appt Time after the customer was already notified (tracked via 'Notified Appt Date'/'Notified Appt Time' columns on the Appointments sheet, added in this same pass — see CRM_SHEET_SCHEMA.md). When a mismatch is found, sends the customer a reschedule SMS, updates the Notified columns + resets Reminder 24h/2h flags (so WF09 sends fresh reminders for the new time), logs the SMS to the Communication Log via the CRM Adapter, and alerts the owner (email by default, SMS optional via CONFIG.SMS_ALERTS_ENABLED). Rows with blank Notified columns (legacy appointments) are silently backfilled with their current Appt Date/Time on the first run instead of triggering a false reschedule notice.
name: Appointment Reschedule Notifier

value.logSummary: ={{ "Appointment rescheduled - notified customer of new time " + $("Build Reschedule Notification Content").item.json.newApptDate + " " + $("Build Reschedule Notification Content").item.json.newApptTime }}

parameters.content: Hourly: reads the Appointments sheet and compares 'Appt Date'/'Appt Time' (current) against 'Notified Appt Date'/'Notified Appt Time' (what the customer was last told) for every row with Status = Scheduled. If they differ, the owner changed the appointment — sends the customer a reschedule SMS with the new time, updates the Notified columns and clears Reminder 24h/2h so WF09 sends fresh reminders for the new time, logs the SMS to the Communication Log via the CRM Adapter, and alerts the owner (email by default, SMS optional via CONFIG.SMS_ALERTS_ENABLED). Rows with blank Notified columns (e.g. brand-new or legacy appointments) are backfilled with their current Appt Date/Time instead of triggering a false notice. CONFIG block lives at the top of 'Detect Appointment Changes'.
